01 / MAKE YOUR CAST

Drag back, then flick toward a fish. Or use Space to start a keyboard cast.

Follow the fish

Cast: pull back, flick forward. Lure: drag to steer, tap to twitch. Bite: swipe up.
Fight: circle the reel or use the wheel. Drag left/right to steer. Tap on a jump to bow. Tap the fish to net.
Keys: arrows steer; Space / Enter cast, twitch, hook, or hold to reel; B bows; N nets; [ / ] adjust drag; 1–3 move spots; P pauses. Optional tilt steering is in the menu.

      TAKE A BREATHER

      On the bank.

      The water will wait. Your game is paused.

      1. Pull back on the water, then flick forward. The arc shows your aim.
      2. Drag slowly to guide the lure. Tap to twitch. Watch fish turn, follow, nip, and strike.
      3. Swipe up when the float dips. Space also sets the hook.
      4. Circle the reel, use the mouse wheel, or hold Space. Steer against the fish. Tap or press B on a jump.
      5. Adjust drag with the slider or [ and ]. Tap the fish, or press N, to use the net.
